intent: Contrast retained melody and forgotten lyrics; ask about humming opening-scene tune without performance result; only performers may go behind stage without actual arrival; improvement after first rehearsal without causal/perfect-score claim; future short play versus completed or long play; audience quiet when lights dim without lights-off inference; applause after song; tiny stage inside old theatre without building-size inference. Six closed diagrams, exact tune evidence and applause event order; theatre/theater variants retained.

三条新信息
只有志愿者可以去屏风后面。我们将在节日活动上演一出短剧。灯光变暗时，观众安静了下来。
词语提示：volunteer志愿者；screen屏风。

options.text: Everyone may go behind the screen. We will perform a short play at the festival. The audience fell silent when the lights dimmed.
Only volunteers may go behind the screen. We have already performed a short play at the festival. The audience fell silent when the lights dimmed.
Only volunteers may go behind the screen. We will perform a short play at the festival. The audience fell silent when the lights dimmed.
Only volunteers may go behind the screen. We will perform a short play at the festival. The audience fell silent when the lights became brighter.
